In the history, the openings of the Saga Plant and the Fukuoka Plant are printed following this. entries.cd27bdd7311b859f: This is a domestic business. The parent company, TOYODA GOSEI CO., LTD., manufactures safety system products, interior and exterior parts and functional parts at its Kasuga Plant (Kiyosu, Aichi Prefecture), Heiwacho Plant (Inazawa, Aichi Prefecture) and Osei Plant (Ichinomiya, Aichi Prefecture), and conducts research and development at its Kitajima Technical Center (Inazawa, Aichi Prefecture) and Miwa Technical Center (Ama, Aichi Prefecture). As of March 31, 2026, the domestic consolidated subsidiaries include Ashimori Industry Co., Ltd. (Settsu, Osaka Prefecture), Toyoda Gosei Higashi Nihon Co., Ltd. (Kurihara, Miyagi Prefecture) and Toyoda Gosei Kyushu Co., Ltd. (Miyawaka, Fukuoka Prefecture), all with voting rights ownership ratios of 100.0%, and Ichiei Kogyo Co., Ltd. (Ichinomiya, Aichi Prefecture) with 65.0%; the relationships are the purchase of the company's products by Ashimori Industry Co., Ltd., Toyoda Gosei Higashi Nihon Co., Ltd. and Ichiei Kogyo Co., Ltd., and the sale of the company's products by Toyoda Gosei Kyushu Co., Ltd. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥447,868 million (up 11.2% year on year), the largest of the 6 reportable segments. As of March 31, 2026, there were 11,670 employees (temporary employees, shown outside this figure, numbered 2,253), of whom 6,657 were employed by the company (1,219 of them temporary employees). The company explains that revenue increased due to higher customer production volumes and other factors. The main customer is [[company:toyota|TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION]] and its subsidiaries, to which revenue is recorded in all reportable segments; revenue from them for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥665,003 million.
